summary.text: Karlee Provenza is a Democratic member of the Wyoming House of Representatives from District 45, serving since January 2021, and is running for re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Karlee Provenza was born in Pueblo, Colorado, and earned a B.A. in psychology from the University of Northern Colorado in 2013, an M.A. in experimental psychology from the University of Wyoming in 2016 and a Ph.D. from the University of Wyoming in 2020.
Provenza's career experience includes working as an educator, waitress, private investigator and professional photographer.
Provenza assumed office in the Wyoming House of Representatives on January 4, 2021, succeeding Charles Pelkey.

For 2025-2026, Provenza's committee assignments include the House Agriculture, State and Public Lands and Water Resources Committee, the House Travel, Recreation, Wildlife and Cultural Resources Committee and the House Rules and Procedure Committee.
